descriere: Sets the signal source for the speed limit of the positive direction on the ramp-function generator input.

descriere_scurta: Speed limit RFG negative direction of rotation
descriere: Sets the signal source for the speed limit of the negative direction on the ramp-function generator input.
Sets the signal source for jog 1.

The ramp-function generator ramps-down the speed setpoint from the maximum speed (p1082) down to standstill (setpoint = 0) in this time. Further, the ramp-down time is always effective for OFF1.
Sets the signal source for bypassing the ramp generator (ramp-up and ramp-down times = 0).
Sets the initial rounding-off time for the extended ramp generator. The value applies to ramp-up and ramp-down.
Sets the final rounding-off time for the extended ramp generator. The value applies to ramp-up and ramp-down.
Sets the smoothed response to the OFF1 command or the reduced setpoint for the extended ramp-function gener- ator.
Sets the initial rounding-off time for OFF3 for the extended ramp generator.
Sets the final rounding-off time for OFF3 for the extended ramp generator.

descriere_scurta: Ramp-function gen., tolerance for ramp-up and ramp-down active
descriere: Sets the tolerance value for the status of the ramp-function generator (ramp-up active, ramp-down active). If the input of the ramp-function generator does not change in comparison to the output by more than the entered tolerance time, then the status bits "ramp-up active" and "ramp-down active" are not influenced.

The value influences the rate at which the output frequency is changed during a flying restart . A higher value results in a longer search time.
Displays the status for checking and monitoring flying restart states in the vector control mode.

Sets the signal source to activate the armature short-circuit or DC brake.
Setting to activate the various types for armature short-circuit / DC brake.

descriere_scurta: Ext. armature short-cct., contactor feedback signal monit. time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time of the contactor feedback signal for the external armature short-circuit configuration. If the contactor feedback signal (p1235) is parameterized, then the appropriate feedback signal (r1239.1) is expected within this monitoring time after either opening or closing the contactor.

descriere_scurta: External armature short-circuit, waiting time when opening
descriere: Sets the delay time when opening the contactor of the external armature short-circuit. If no contactor feedback signal has been selected (p1235), then the system waits for this time before the pulses are switched in.

descriere_scurta: Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration
descriere: Sets the controller configuration of the DC link voltage (Vdc controller) in the closed-loop control mode.

If subsequent optimization is required, this can be carried out using the dynamic factor. In this case p1250, p1251,

Sets the dynamic factor for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). 100% means that p1250, p1251, and p1252 (gain, integral time, and rate time) are used corresponding to their basic settings and based on a theoretical controller optimization. If subsequent optimization is required, this can be carried out using the dynamic factor. In this case p1250, p1251,
Sets the proportional gain for the DC-link voltage controller (Vdc_min controller, Vdc_max controller).
Sets the integral time for the DC-link voltage controller (Vdc_min controller, Vdc_max controller).
Sets the time threshold for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). If this value is exceeded a fault is output; the required response can be parameterized. Prerequisite: p1256 = 1.
Sets the response for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering).
Sets the speed threshold for the Vdc-min controller (kinetic buffering). If this value is exceeded a fault is output; the required response can be parameterized .

descriere_scurta: Vdc controller or Vdc monitoring configuration (V/f)
descriere: Sets the configuration of the controller for the DC link voltage (Vdc controller) in the V/f operating mode.
Sets the switch-in level for the Vdc-min controller (kinetic buffering). The value is obtained as follows: AC/AC unit: p1286[V] = p1285[%] * sqrt(2) * p0210 DC/AC unit: p1286[V] = p1285[%] * p0210

Sets the dynamic factor for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). 100% means that p1290, p1291, and p1292 (gain, integral time, and rate time) are used corresponding to their basic settings and based on a theoretical controller optimization. If subsequent optimization is required, this can be carried out using the dynamic factor. In this case, p1290, p1291, and p1292 are weighted with the dynamic factor p1287. If several modules are connected to the DC link, then the dynamic factor must be increased corresponding to the ratio of the additional capacitances to the capacitance of the module involved.

descriere_scurta: Vdc_max controller feedback coupling factor ramp-fct. gen. (V/f) /
descriere: Sets the feedback factor for the ramp-function generator. Its ramp times are decelerated relative to the output signal of the Vdc_max controller.
Sets the lower speed threshold for the Vdc_max controller. When this speed threshold is undershot, the Vdc_max control is switched out and the speed is controlled using the ramp-function generator.
Sets the proportional gain for the Vdc controller (DC link voltage controller).
Sets the integral time for the Vdc controller (DC link voltage controller).
Sets the output limit for the Vdc min controller (DC link undervoltage controller).
Sets the time threshold for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering). If this value is exceeded a fault is output; the required response can be parameterized. Prerequisite: p1296 = 1.
Sets the response for the Vdc_min controller (kinetic buffering).
Sets the speed threshold for the Vdc-min controller (kinetic buffering). If this value is exceeded a fault is output; the required response can be parameterized .

p1311 only results in a voltage boost when accelerating and generates a supplementary torque to accelerate the load. The voltage boost becomes effective for a positive setpoint increase and disappears as soon as the setpoint has been reached. The build-up and withdrawal of the voltage boost are smoothed. The magnitude of the boost in Volt at a frequency of zero is defined as follows: Voltage boost [V] = 1.732 * p0305 (rated motor current [A]) x r0395 (stator/primary section resistance [ohm]) x

descriere: Sets the starting frequency of the slip compensation.
Sets the limit value for slip compensation in [%] referred to r0330 (motor rated slip).

descriere_scurta: V/f mode resonance damping filter time constant
descriere: Sets the filter time constant for resonance damping for V/f control.
Sets the proportional gain for the I_max voltage controller.

descriere_scurta: V/f mode resonance damping maximum frequency
descriere: Sets the maximum output frequency for resonance damping for V/f control. Resonance damping is inactive above this output frequency.
Sets whether the voltage is continuously increased during the magnetizing phase (p1350 = 1, On) or whether it jumps directly to the voltage boost (p1350 = 0, Off).
Sets the frequency setting value at the slip compensation output for starting up with motor holding brake.

Sets the dead time for the symmetrizing of the actual angle value for the differential angular generation. The selected multiplier refers to the current controller clock cycle (dead time= p1358 * p0115[0]).

descriere_scurta: Speed controller reference model natural frequency
descriere: Sets the natural frequency of a PT2 element for the reference model of the speed controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller reference model dead time
descriere: Sets the "fractional" dead time for the reference model of the speed controller. This parameter emulates the computing dead time of the proportionally controlled speed control loop. The selected multiplier refers to the speed controller clock cycle (dead time= p1435 * p0115[1]).

descriere: Sets the signal source for speed setpoint for the integral component of the speed controller.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller speed actual value smoothing time
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the actual speed value of the speed controller for closed-loop control with encoder.

descriere_scurta: Motor model speed actual value smoothing time SLVC
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the speed actual value calculated by the motor model in sensorless operation.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller speed actual value smoothing time (SLVC)
descriere: Sets the smoothing time for the actual speed of the speed controller for encoderless closed-loop speed control.

descriere_scurta: Speed controller P gain adaptation signal
descriere: Sets the source for the adaptation signal to additionally adapt the P gain of the speed controller.
